Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Electrician Snapshot: Custom Values

In our electrician snapshot, we provide customizable values aimed at enhancing your electrician business's efficiency and effectiveness in marketing and service delivery. These custom values empower you to streamline processes, improve customer satisfaction, and drive business growth effectively.

Customer Referral Campaign

This value represents the details of a customer referral campaign designed to incentivize existing customers to refer new clients to your electrician business. It may include rewards, discounts, or other incentives for successful referrals, fostering word-of-mouth marketing and customer loyalty.

DR Campaign Offer

The DR campaign offer is a customizable value that serves as an incentive for potential clients to engage with your electrician services. It may include special promotions, discounts, or packages designed to attract new customers and drive conversions through direct response marketing efforts.

Estimate Calendar

This value provides a direct link to your estimate calendar, allowing potential clients to schedule estimates for electrical services conveniently. It simplifies the booking process and ensures efficient time management for both you and your clients.

Funnel Offer

The funnel offer is a customizable value associated with specific marketing funnels aimed at guiding potential clients through a series of steps to take a specific action, such as booking an appointment or requesting a quote for electrical services. It may include discounts, promotions, or incentives tailored to each funnel's objectives.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management)

This link directs clients to leave continuous reviews for your electrician business on platforms like Google. It helps build and maintain a positive online reputation, which is essential for attracting new clients and retaining existing ones.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign)

Similar to continuous reputation management, this link is associated with a specific review campaign aimed at prompting clients to leave reviews for your electrician business. It contributes to your online credibility and visibility, enhancing your reputation in the industry.

Holiday Email Offer

The holiday email offer provides a special promotion or discount tailored for holiday seasons. It allows you to capitalize on seasonal trends and festivities to attract new clients or encourage repeat business from existing ones.

Service Area

This value specifies the geographical area where your electrician services are available. It helps potential clients determine if your services are accessible to them and ensures accurate communication regarding service availability.

These custom values enable you to customize and optimize various aspects of your electrician business, from marketing campaigns to service delivery, ultimately driving success and growth in the electrical industry.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR (Direct Response) campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main Electrician Leads Pipeline: The main electrician leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your electrician -related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your electrician business.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the electrician snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the electrician Consultation Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

6. Funnels

Electrician Snapshot: Funnels

Funnels are structured marketing frameworks designed to guide potential clients through a series of steps, ultimately leading them to take a specific action, such as booking an appointment or downloading a resource. In our electrician snapshot, we offer three specialized funnels tailored to attract, engage, and convert leads effectively.

15% Off Services Funnel

The 15% Off Services Funnel incentivizes potential clients to book electrical services by offering a discount. This three-step funnel includes an opt-in process, appointment booking, and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Opt-In Process: Engages potential clients by offering a 15% discount in exchange for their contact information.

Appointment Booking: Guides clients through the process of scheduling electrical services and redeeming the discount.

Thank-You Page: Expresses gratitude to clients for booking services and provides further information or instructions.

Benefits:

Conversion Incentive: Provides a compelling offer to motivate clients to schedule electrical services, driving conversions.

Discount Promotion: Encourages immediate action by offering a discount, increasing the likelihood of booking appointments.

Electrical Safety Checklist Funnel

The Electrical Safety Checklist Funnel offers potential clients access to valuable resources related to electrical safety. This two-step lead magnet funnel includes an opt-in process and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Opt-In Form: Collects potential clients' contact information in exchange for access to the electrical safety checklist.

Thank-You Page: Provides access to the checklist and expresses appreciation to clients for their interest.

Benefits:

Lead Generation: Captures contact information from potential clients interested in electrical safety, expanding your client base and fostering engagement.

Educational Outreach: Provides valuable resources to potential clients, positioning your business as a trusted authority in electrical safety.

VSL (Video Sales Letter) Funnel

The VSL Funnel utilizes video content to engage potential clients and encourage them to book electrical services. This three-step funnel includes a video page, a calendar page for booking appointments, and a thank-you page. Key features include:

Video Page: Presents engaging video content showcasing the benefits of your electrical services and offers.

Calendar Page: Guides clients through the process of scheduling appointments after watching the video.

Thank-You Page: Confirms the successful scheduling of the appointment and provides further details or instructions.

Benefits:

Engaging Content: Captivates potential clients with compelling video content, increasing interest and engagement.

Seamless Booking Process: Streamlines the process of scheduling appointments after watching the video, improving convenience and accessibility.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the electrician. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the electrician, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the electrician, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the electrician, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. 14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your electrician business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your electrician business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
